title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 5, section 33 (Elbow Lake)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 5 No Shooting Areas (Section 6)
Elbow Lake
33 That portion of the Province of British Columbia, being all the area 0.8 km (1/2 mile) on either side of the centreline of the portion of the Canadian Forest Products Chehalis Main Road, in the vicinity of Elbow Lake, NWD, which is contained within the following boundaries: The Canadian Forest Products Chehalis Main Road commencing at the point due West of the most northerly portion of Elbow Lake; thence northerly for a distance of 2.4 km (1.5 miles).
